title: Healthy habit of the day: Build meals around protein and fibre
excerpt: Meals that include protein (such as dal, eggs, fish, paneer or beans) and fibre (vegetables, fruit, whole grains) tend to keep you fuller for longer.
content: Meals that include protein (such as dal, eggs, fish, paneer or beans) and fibre (vegetables, fruit, whole grains) tend to keep you fuller for longer.
Try adding vegetables or pulses to each main meal instead of cutting whole food groups out.
This is general information, not medical advice. Speak to a doctor or dietitian before changing your diet or exercise, especially if you have a health condition.
